# Design Catalog — full agent briefing

Base: https://design-catalog-three.vercel.app
Generated static JSON under /data/ (regenerated on npm run build).

## Purpose

Machine-readable + human-readable catalog of public AI design craft notes so agents can:

- Escape SaaS-landing / “vibe purple” priors (seed strings, ambitious briefs, anti-tells)
- Structure prompts (TC-EBC; thinking before prompt)
- Run critic loops on screenshots
- Enrich with image/video/motion and “make it alive”
- Deliver with cut + kill-list + hand-rewritten copy

Quiet Folio visual system: paper #FAF9F7 · ink #221C24 · studioInk #6F6470 · hairline #E8E3E8. No AI chrome.

## Fetch order

1. GET /data/index.json — overview, routes, anshuMapping, canonicalApps
2. Filter techniques by stage or slug list
3. GET /data/techniques/{slug}.json for procedure, examplePrompts, promptWhy, checklist, antiPatterns, pairsWellWith, workedExamples
4. GET /data/prompts.json when you need a flattened prompt library
5. Cite /data/sources.json; never invent paywalled quotes
6. Free craft libraries: /data/resources.json or /resources (transitions, shaders, easing, examples, textures—free first)

## Anshu 1–8 ↔ Build Games Phase A

| 1 | seed-strings | Discover | docs/DISCOVER.md |

| 3 | critic-subagents | Define | docs/DEFINE.md |
| 4 | image-generation | Define | docs/DEFINE.md |
| 5 | video-motion | Define | docs/DEFINE.md |
| 6 | cut-elements | Deliver | docs/DELIVER.md |
| 7 | remove-ai-tells | Deliver | docs/DELIVER.md |
| 8 | hand-rewrite-copy | Deliver | docs/DELIVER.md |

## Tileboard (chore-app) path

- Live candidate: https://buildgames-tody.vercel.app
- Original: https://todyapp.com/
- Process: full Anshu 1–8 reseed, then ≤25 beat-the-original loops with spottable ~3s deltas
- Catalog: /compare · /prompts · /techniques · /designers/anshu-chimala
